name: Geometry Processing
description: Introduction to interpolation and approximation theory, Spline curves and surfaces, subdivision surfaces, CSG, surface analysis using differential geometry, level-of-detail representations, progressive meshes, introduction to character animation, riging, scinning and layering, locomotion, motion capturing and (space-time) control, character modeling
prerequisites: MA0902 Analysis für Informatiker, MA0901 Lineare Algebra für Informatiker
